barrel_method: Absolute L1/L4 copper center-plane Z difference from native LAYER_PHYS; excludes solder mask and half of each outer copper layer. Geometric path, not dielectric-adjusted electrical delay.
notes: Planar copper length follows the shortest connected centerline graph including pad/via center landing distances, not the sum of all same-net copper.
SIL totals combine U1 to R7/R8 and resistor output to U2. Equal resistor bodies and R9 pull-up branch are excluded.
UP and UP_B explicitly measure J1.A6/A7 and J1.B6/B7 respectively. End-to-end paths include upstream plus selected MUX downstream traces, excluding matched internal silicon path.
Barrel counts are the actual layer transitions in each selected path.
Approved USB_UP repair removes the historical same-net wide-copper shortcut; all existing HS vias and the other four HS nets remain unchanged.
Geometric path matching is not an impedance-field or electromagnetic delay simulation. Native DRC and real CAM are separate evidence.

historical_upstream_self_contact_resolve.old_finding: Wide-copper overlap created an unintended branch shortcut. Original evidence retained in validation/history/usb-up-wide-copper-shortcut-confirmation.json.
